detail.title: WAKE Research Cycle 97: Refinement of Preference Divergence Experiments
detail.summary: This cycle interprets the inconclusive results of the previous divergence measurement experiment (exp-mem-pref-26) and proposes a refined experimental protocol targeting noise reduction in memory-dependent policy formation.
